articles.summary: ORKA-002 interim Phase 1 data demonstrates a half-life of 75-80 days supporting potential for twice-per-year dosing in psoriasis and quarterly dosing in hidradenitis suppurativa Phase 2 studies for ORKA-002 expected to begin in 1H 2026 for psoriasis and 2H 2026 for hidradenitis suppurativa First
articles.title: Oruka Therapeutics Announces Positive Interim Phase 1 Data for ORKA-002 and Initiation of EVERLAST-B Trial of ORKA-001
